QUOTE: "`NavigationHeader` (`app/components/navigation_header/index.tsx`) is a `forwardRef<SearchRef, Props>`. It doesn't use the ref itself. It forwards it to `<NavigationSearch ... ref={ref}>`, but only when `hasSearch` is true."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true. The "attached to nothing otherwise" part is implied by the conditional.
